MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Breeze feels like a natural next choice because Old Sock left me interested in more Clapton, especially relaxed blues material.",
    "Different Shades Of Blue fits the blues guitar interest reflected in People, Hell & Angels, while The Band offers a roots-rock connection that also appeals to me."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Orchestral Elvis takes the music in a direction I am less interested in right now; I am more drawn to blues guitar and roots sounds.",
    "Titles such as Gold, Original Album Series, and ON AIR Deluxe do not give me enough evidence of a musical connection to choose them. That uncertainty does not mean I dislike the recordings.",
    "Sgt. Pepper's appeals to my broader classic-rock taste, but that does not make an expanded edition something I want today."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The choices seem to treat a broad interest in classic rock as enough to make many familiar older acts equally appealing.",
    "Collections and deluxe editions seem to be treated as natural next choices, although my recent listening gives little reason to think I want expanded sets."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The direct connection to Clapton and the blues guitar thread matter more to me right now than a broad classic-rock connection.",
    "I rarely choose much at once, so an album can fit my taste without being compelling enough to choose alongside my strongest blues matches.",
    "For unfamiliar or ambiguous titles, I need a recognizable artist or musical connection before I feel interested enough to act."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my blues and roots interests, but stretched them into broader classic-rock and collection choices that give me less reason to act now."
}
